title: Need Timely Customer Service? Don’t Hold Your Breath!
text:
Need Timely Customer Service? Don’t Hold Your Breath!. I gave this company one star because a good, dependable product is only half of a satisfactory purchase. Real time human to human tech support is just as important! The pressure cooker works very well until it doesn’t. Then, heaven help you if your questions or concerns aren’t completely answered in their manual! I have been trying to contact an actual human in their customer “service” department for days.
First of all, they are closed on the weekend. Perhaps they think people who use their products don’t need to eat on the weekends. Yesterday, Monday, I tried to get in touch with them continuously for just under an hour. Every time, I was given the treat of classical music (nice for a change actually) and then told no one is available and to leave a message to get a call within 48 hours- 48 hours! Since I called starting around 10:30, today, Tuesday, I purposely got up 2 hours early hoping to get through. (How dare people not live on the East coast!) It didn’t matter; 7:30 AM and I can’t get through. Of cource, I was given the option of emailing them. Yes, I have the time to spend a half hour explaining my situation and all the variables that make this situation potentially different from their little manual. Why should Fagor employ people to help their customers directly when their customers can do their work?
Bottom line? Think very seriously about the level of frustration you are willing to put up with before dealing with Fagor!

product_metadata.title: Fagor 670042050 LUX Multi Cooker - 4 Quart, Brushed Stainless Steel
features: Pressure cooking on both high and low options up to 99 minutes. Slow Cooking high or low options up to 10 hours
Keep warm function up to 12 hours and Time Delay function up to 6 hours
Cook a variety of meals including Creamy Risotto, Chile con Carne, Steamed Salmon Fillets and desserts like Chocolate Bread Pudding and Yogurt
Removable Non-Stick ceramic cooking pot is dishwasher safe, PFOA free and FDA safe. Has a convenient measuring guide inside
Unit includes a user's manual, recipe booklet and a free digital recipe book with more than 75 delicious recipes - Uses regular 110 - 120V. 1000 watts
description: The Fagor LUX Multi-Cooker is a state of the art electric cooker that is a pressure cooker, slow cooker, rice cooker and yogurt maker all-in-one. Additional assist functions such as brown, saute, simmer, steam and keep warm make this unit an essential kitchen tool. The unit has easily accessed featured functions: Pressure Cooking (high and low), Slow Cooking (high and low), Rice Cooking (white rice, brown rice and risotto) and finally a setting for Yogurt. 6 Quarts capacity .
